visual_appearance.text: Ignore: Motion blur that softens a moving subject's skin or hair boundaries during fast movement.
Report: A subject's surface lacking fine texture while adjacent high-frequency details remain sharp.
Ignore: Global softness or compression artifacts that uniformly reduce detail across the entire frame.
Ignore: Smooth skin or facial surfaces that lack fine pore detail due to beauty filters or high compression.
Report: Facial or hand contours that locally melt or duplicate while surrounding background details remain sharp.

common_sense.text: Report: A character's body or props shifting into a physically incompatible form or scale during a transition.
Report: A physical object appearing on the ground with a spill or impact mark lacking a visible causal action.
Ignore: Stylized or game-like environments where objects or animals behave according to internal rules.
